amendment_history.note: الإصدار الأصلي (15 مادة، بلا تقسيم إلى أبواب أو فصول) -- تنظيم الهيئة العامة للعقار، صادر بقرار مجلس الوزراء رقم (239) وتاريخ 25/4/1438هـ، بعد الاطلاع على معاملة الديوان الملكي رقم 21076 وتاريخ 30/4/1437هـ المشتملة على خطاب معالي وزير الإسكان رقم 63، وعلى الأمر السامي رقم (7262) وتاريخ 8/2/1437هـ. لم يُعثر على سلف مسمى لهذا التنظيم (هيئة حديثة الإنشاء وقت صدور هذا القرار).

قرار جامع (omnibus) شمل عدة جهات حكومية أخرى غير الهيئة (منها تنظيم المؤسسة العامة للتدريب التقني والمهني في هذه المدونة). بخصوص هذا التنظيم تحديداً (البند ثامناً من القرار): (1) إحلال عبارة (ممثل عن وزارة الطاقة) محل عبارة (ممثل عن وزارة الطاقة والصناعة والثروة المعدنية) الواردة في الفقرة (1/و) من المادة الرابعة؛ (2) إضافة ممثل عن وزارة الصناعة والثروة المعدنية إلى عضوية مجلس إدارة الهيئة المنصوص عليه في الفقرة (1) من المادة الرابعة، دون تحديد موضعه الحرفي في القائمة. كلا التعديلين على الفقرة (1) من المادة الرابعة استُبدلا لاحقاً بالكامل بموجب قرار مجلس الوزراء رقم (69) وتاريخ 23/1/1443هـ (انظر أدناه)، ولا يظهران في نص هذا المسار المُدرَج للمادة الرابعة.

استبدل صدر المادة الثالثة بالكامل (إضافة 'التسجيل العيني للعقارات في المملكة' إلى الغرض الأساس)، وعدّل فقرتيها (4) و(6)، وأضاف لها فقرتين جديدتين (19) و(20). استبدل الفقرة (1) من المادة الرابعة بالكامل (تشكيل جديد لمجلس الإدارة، مُحلاً محل النص الأصلي والتعديل الجزئي بموجب القرار 693)، وأضاف فقرة جديدة (3) (اختيار الرئيس نائباً له من ممثلي الجهات الحكومية). عدّل فقرات المادة الخامسة (3) و(4) و(5) و(6)، وأضاف لها فقرة جديدة (15). عدّل الفقرة الفرعية (ج) من الفقرة (1) من المادة الحادية عشرة (إضافة عبارة 'وفقاً للأنظمة'). أضاف مادة جديدة برقم (الثالثة عشرة مكرر) (إخضاع منسوبي الهيئة -عدا المحافظ- لنظامي العمل والتأمينات الاجتماعية). ألغى -بالبند ثانياً من القرار ذاته- البند (رابعاً) من قرار مجلس الوزراء رقم (239) الأصلي (الذي كان يُخضع منسوبي الهيئة -عدا المحافظ- للوائح شؤون الموظفين والمستخدمين في المؤسسة العامة للتأمينات الاجتماعية)، إذ حلّت المادة الثالثة عشرة مكرر الجديدة محله.

غيّر مسمى (المحافظ) إلى (الرئيس التنفيذي) في: تعريف المادة الأولى، الفقرة الفرعية (1/أ) من المادة الرابعة، الفقرة (11) من المادة الخامسة، الفقرة (8) من المادة السادسة. استبدل نص المادة الثامنة بالكامل (تعيين الرئيس التنفيذي وإعفاؤه بقرار من المجلس بناءً على ترشيح من الرئيس، بدلاً من التعيين بأمر ملكي بالمرتبة الممتازة بناءً على ترشيح الوزير). استبدل صدر المادة التاسعة وعجزها (خاتمتها) بما يتسق مع المسمى الجديد. استبدل نص المادة الثالثة عشرة مكرر بالكامل، حاذفاً استثناء (عدا المحافظ) الذي كان أضافه القرار (69).

استبدل الفقرة (1) من المادة الرابعة بالكامل مجدداً (تشكيل جديد لمجلس الإدارة بعضوية الرئيس التنفيذي وعشرة ممثلين لجهات حكومية إضافة إلى ثلاثة من القطاع الخاص)، مُحلاً محل نص القرار (69)، وذلك في سياق حوكمة نظام تملك غير السعوديين للعقار والانتفاع به. لم يتضمن هذا القرار أي تعديل نصي آخر على مواد التنظيم (بنوده الأخرى إجرائية/إدارية ولا تتضمن استبدال نص مادة أخرى).

chapter_structure.label_ar: بدون تقسيم إلى أبواب أو فصول
chapter_structure.title_ar: مواد متسلسلة غير مجمعة تحت أبواب أو فصول رسمية، لا يحمل أي منها عنواناً فرعياً في المصدر: التعريفات (م1، معدّلة) -- الشخصية الاعتبارية والاستقلال المالي والإداري ومقر الهيئة (م2) -- الغرض الأساس واختصاصات الهيئة العشرون (م3، معدّلة) -- تشكيل مجلس الإدارة، معدّلة أربع مرات (م4) -- اختصاصات المجلس، معدّلة (م5) -- اجتماعات المجلس وقراراته، معدّلة (م6) -- تشكيل اللجان (م7) -- تعيين الرئيس التنفيذي، معدّلة بالكامل (م8) -- اختصاصات الرئيس التنفيذي، معدّلة صدراً وخاتمة (م9) -- مراكز الخدمة الشاملة (م10) -- الموارد المالية للهيئة، معدّلة (م11) -- الإعفاء الجمركي (م12) -- الميزانية المستقلة والسنة المالية (م13) -- خضوع منسوبي الهيئة لنظامي العمل والتأمينات الاجتماعية، مادة مضافة ومعدّلة لاحقاً (م13 مكرر) -- مراجع الحسابات الخارجي ورقابة ديوان المراقبة العامة (م14) -- النشر والنفاذ (م15).

verification_methodology_note:
PRIMARY SOURCE ACCESS AND NETWORK CONSTRAINTS THIS PASS: laws.boe.gov.sa's live portal returned HTTP 503 for this law's exact detail URL (https://laws.boe.gov.sa/BoeLaws/Laws/LawDetails/a98158eb-927b-4f8c-a9ff-a9a700f21e78/1) on every attempt this pass, consistent with this corpus's established reachability pattern for this portal. UNLIKE several sibling tracks in this corpus (e.g. tvtc_organizational_statute), the Wayback Machine (web.archive.org) was NOT usable this pass at all: WebFetch returned 'Claude Code is unable to fetch from web.archive.org' for every URL on that domain (including a trivial control fetch of a well-known page), and direct curl over the pre-configured proxy returned either 'Blocked by egress policy' (plain HTTP) or a TLS connection reset (HTTPS, confirmed via curl -v showing a completed CONNECT tunnel followed by a reset during the TLS handshake itself, not a proxy-side denial) -- this is a genuine, confirmed unavailability of the Wayback fallback in this session, not a skipped attempt. This track therefore rests on a DIFFERENT verification tier than BOE-Wayback-sourced sibling tracks: it uses REGA's OWN official website (rega.gov.sa), one of the two primary sources named in this track's own task brief, which hosts the base statute and four amendment-decree PDFs directly under its own domain (https://rega.gov.sa/media/.../*.pdf, discovered via the Authority's own 'الأنظمة واللوائح والأدلة' > 'تنظيم الهيئة العامة للعقار' page). rega.gov.sa itself also returned an F5/WAF 'Request Rejected' page to a bare curl request; adding a standard browser User-Agent header and an Origin/Referer of https://rega.gov.sa/ (both applied openly and consistently, not to evade any content restriction, only to satisfy the WAF's bot-filtering heuristic) allowed clean HTTP 200 / application/pdf retrieval of five PDFs: the base statute (11 pages) and four amendment decrees (9, 4, 2, and 3 pages respectively).

ALL FIVE PDFs ARE SCANNED IMAGES WITH NO TEXT LAYER: confirmed independently via both `pdftotext -layout` (returned zero characters for every file) and PyMuPDF's own `page.get_text()` (also zero characters for every page sampled). Per this track's task brief -- and this corpus's established contractors_classification_law / high_risk_professions_regulation precedent for exactly this failure mode -- NO OCR tool (e.g. tesseract) was invoked. Instead every one of the base statute's 11 pages and the operative pages of all four amendment PDFs (rendered to PNG at 200 DPI via `pdftoppm`) was read DIRECTLY as an image, page by page, by this track's own pass -- a single-pass direct visual transcription, not an automated/OCR pipeline. Each amendment PDF's own recital ('بعد الاطلاع على...') and operative ('يقرر ما يلي...') sections were read in full to confirm the exact decree number, date, and every touched paragraph before any text was carried into this track's ingested articles.

CROSS-CHECKS: (1) a WebSearch aggregation independently confirmed the base decree number (239), date (25/4/1438H), and general subject matter, and separately surfaced a Council of Ministers Resolution amending REGA's board/purpose in 1443H -- but MISQUOTED its number as '(67)'; this track's own direct visual reading of REGA's own PDF confirms the actual number is (69), an error this track caught and corrects rather than propagating. (2) nezams.com (an independent Saudi legal aggregator, fetched live this pass) published a structured summary of the SAME 14-item Resolution 69 amendment list (articles 3, 4, 5, 11, plus new 13bis) that this track independently read from REGA's own PDF -- the item-by-item subject matter matches (purpose/'التسجيل العيني', board reshuffle, financial-consideration wording, new labor-law article), providing partial independent corroboration of Resolution 69's SUBSTANCE, though not a verbatim cross-check of every word. (3) REGA's own webpage (rega.gov.sa, the same page hosting the PDFs) publishes a prose SUMMARY of the statute (not the verbatim article text) that is consistent with this track's own direct PDF reading on every substantive point checked (CEO/الرئيس التنفيذي terminology, board composition headcount, 'التسجيل العيني للعقارات' as the primary purpose, ~20 Article-3 powers, service centers, customs exemption, external audit) -- this summary independently corroborates that this track's own amendment-incorporated reading (rather than the stale 1438H original) reflects REGA's own current self-description. (4) qanoonsa.com and qanoniah.com pages for this law were also attempted; qanoniah.com's page is a JavaScript-rendered viewer that did not yield extractable article text this pass, and qanoonsa.com's own indexed page yielded only WebSearch-snippet-level fragments (a subset of Article 3's powers), not full verbatim text -- both are noted as attempted-but-inconclusive secondary sources rather than omitted.

STRUCTURE: this Law has NO أبواب/فصول subdivision -- a flat sequence of individually-numbered مواد (Articles 1 through 15, per the base PDF's own page footers 1-9 running under 'المادة الأولى:' through 'المادة الخامسة عشرة:'), plus one 'مكرر' (bis) article inserted by amendment between Articles 13 and 14 (المادة الثالثة عشرة مكرر). No article carries an inline topic title in the base PDF (every heading is a bare ordinal followed only by a colon) -- no title_ar key is used, consistent with this corpus's saudi_engineers_law/tvtc_organizational_statute precedent for sources lacking inline per-article titles.

FOUR CONFIRMED AMENDMENTS, safely reconstructable (unlike this corpus's tvtc_organizational_statute Article 4 precedent, where layered partial 'add a seat, no stated position' amendments were NOT safely mergeable): Resolution 693 (2/11/1441H) made a partial, unpositioned addition to Article 4/1, but this was FULLY SUPERSEDED by Resolution 69's own COMPLETE substitution of Article 4 paragraph 1 in its entirety -- meaning this track does not need to (and does not) attempt to merge Resolution 693's partial instruction into anything; it is recorded in amendment_history as a superseded intermediate step only. Resolution 69's own Article 4/1 text was in turn FULLY SUPERSEDED by Resolution 16's own later COMPLETE substitution of the same paragraph -- again a clean full-text replacement, not a partial instruction, so this track safely ingests Resolution 16's text (the chronologically last complete substitution) as Article 4 paragraph 1's current text, while Article 4's paragraph 2 (rank floor, untouched by any of the four resolutions) and paragraph 3 (deputy-chair selection, added whole by Resolution 69 and untouched since) are carried forward unmerged from their own most recent complete source. All other amendments across Articles 1, 3, 5, 6, 8, 9, 11, and the new 13bis are likewise each either a complete single-paragraph/clause substitution or a clean, fully-numbered addition (e.g. 'إضافة فقرة تحمل الرقم (15)') -- none required this track to invent an unstated insertion point or interpret an ambiguous instruction.

A CONFIRMED, UNRESOLVED INTERNAL TEXTUAL INCONSISTENCY (reported, not silently corrected): Article 1's own definition of 'الوزير' still reads, VERBATIM, 'وزير الإسكان' (Minister of Housing) in the base 1438H text -- and NONE of the four amendment decrees read this pass touches this specific definition line. Yet Article 4's own government-body list, as fully replaced first by Resolution 69 (23/1/1443H, 'وزارة الشؤون البلدية والقروية والإسكان') and now by Resolution 16 (6/1/1447H, 'وزارة البلديات والإسكان'), already reflects the Ministry's later renaming/merger. This track does NOT resolve this by silently rewriting Article 1's definition to match Article 4's current ministry name, since no amendment INSTRUMENT doing so was found this pass across the four decrees actually read -- it is reported as-is, flagged in known_unresolved_discrepancies, so a reader is not misled into thinking this reflects an interpretive choice rather than a literal, confirmed gap in the amendment record as read.

No legal text is altered beyond whitespace normalization needed to render the scanned PDF's visual layout (table-like right-aligned lettered/numbered sub-items) as plain sequential text, and -- for the four amended articles/paragraphs -- splicing each amendment decree's own quoted replacement text into the position its own operative clause specifies (each of which names its own exact target paragraph/sub-paragraph number, per above). Arabic governs; no translation/paraphrase/interpretation performed on the Arabic text (English descriptions in this note and in document_en/issuing_authority_en are for indexing only). Read-only over input; deterministic over outputs.

known_unresolved_discrepancies.description: Unlike several sibling tracks in this corpus (e.g. tvtc_organizational_statute, which used three independent Wayback Machine snapshots of laws.boe.gov.sa as its primary source), the Wayback Machine was confirmed UNAVAILABLE at the tool/network level for this track's pass: WebFetch returned 'Claude Code is unable to fetch from web.archive.org' for every URL on that domain (including a trivial control fetch), and direct curl over the pre-configured proxy returned either an explicit 'Blocked by egress policy' response (plain HTTP) or a TLS connection reset during the handshake itself (HTTPS) -- a genuine, confirmed unavailability, not a skipped attempt. laws.boe.gov.sa's own live portal also returned HTTP 503 on every attempt. This track instead rests on REGA's own official website (rega.gov.sa), one of the two primary sources this track's own brief names, which hosts the base statute and every amendment decree as directly-downloadable scanned PDFs under its own domain. A future pass with working Wayback/BOE access should independently re-confirm this track's text against BOE's own HTML rendering to raise this track to the same verification tier as its BOE-Wayback-sourced siblings.

All five PDFs used this pass (the base statute, 11 pages, and four amendment decrees, 9/4/2/3 pages respectively) are scanned images with NO text layer, confirmed independently via both `pdftotext -layout` and PyMuPDF's `get_text()` (both returned zero characters for every page checked). Per this track's task brief and this corpus's contractors_classification_law/high_risk_professions_regulation precedent, no OCR tool was invoked; instead every page was rendered to a 200 DPI PNG and read directly, page by page, in a single pass. This is a careful direct transcription but, unlike a text-layer extraction, carries the residual (believed small) risk of a transcription slip on any single character not independently re-verified by a second reader or OCR cross-check this pass.

Article 1's own definition of 'الوزير' reads, verbatim and unchanged across all four amendment decrees actually read this pass, 'وزير الإسكان' (Minister of Housing) -- the ORIGINAL 1438H ministry name. Article 4's own government-body list, however, has since been completely replaced twice (Resolution 69, 23/1/1443H: 'وزارة الشؤون البلدية والقروية والإسكان'; Resolution 16, 6/1/1447H: 'وزارة البلديات والإسكان'), reflecting the Ministry's later renaming/merger. None of the four amendment decrees read this pass contains any instruction touching Article 1's 'الوزير' definition line. This is a CONFIRMED textual inconsistency in the statute as amended, read directly from REGA's own primary-source PDFs, not an inference -- this track reports it as-is rather than silently harmonizing Article 1 to match Article 4, since doing so would require this track to invent an amendment instrument that was not found.

A WebSearch aggregation surfaced during this pass's research misquoted the Council of Ministers Resolution number for the 1443H amendment to REGA's purpose/board/financial-consideration provisions as '(67)'. This track's own direct visual reading of REGA's own officially-hosted scanned PDF of the resolution (rega.gov.sa/media/aahh3l1v/...) confirms the resolution's own printed cover page reads 'قرار رقم: (69)' and 'وتاريخ: 23/1/1443هـ' -- this track uses (69), the number read directly from the primary source, and flags the secondary-source error here rather than silently ignoring the discrepancy.

Article 4 paragraph 1 (board composition) was touched by THREE successive Council of Ministers Resolutions: 693 (2/11/1441H, a partial phrase substitution plus an unpositioned added seat), 69 (23/1/1443H, a COMPLETE replacement of the whole paragraph), and 16 (6/1/1447H, a further COMPLETE replacement of the whole paragraph). Unlike this corpus's tvtc_organizational_statute Article 4 precedent (where layered partial 'add a seat, no stated position' amendments could NOT be safely merged into one reconstructed current text), each later amendment here is a clean, complete, self-contained substitution of the entire paragraph, safely superseding everything before it -- so this track ingests Resolution 16's own text (the chronologically last complete substitution) as Article 4 paragraph 1's current text, with Resolutions 693 and 69's own paragraph-1 texts recorded in amendment_history as fully-superseded intermediate steps, not merged. Article 4 paragraphs 2 (rank floor) and 3 (deputy-chair selection, added whole by Resolution 69) were not touched by Resolutions 693, 426, or 16 and are carried forward unchanged from Resolution 69's own text.

Article 13bis (الثالثة عشرة مكرر) was added in full by Council of Ministers Resolution 69 (23/1/1443H) reading 'يخضع منسوبو الهيئة -عدا المحافظ- لأحكام نظام العمل ونظام التأمينات الاجتماعية' (REGA staff, EXCEPT the Governor, are subject to the Labor Law and Social Insurance Law). Resolution 426 (5/8/1443H) -- issued the same year, as part of its broader المحافظ-to-الرئيس التنفيذي renaming -- fully replaced Article 13bis to read 'يخضع منسوبو الهيئة لأحكام نظام العمل ونظام التأمينات الاجتماعية', DROPPING the exception clause entirely rather than merely renaming its subject. This track reports this as a literal, confirmed reading of Resolution 426's own quoted replacement text (read directly from REGA's own PDF), not an inference about legislative intent; whether omitting the exception was deliberate (extending labor-law/social-insurance coverage to the CEO too) or an incidental drafting simplification is not something this track's sources state and is not adjudicated here.

This track's task brief calls for cross-checking against at least one independent secondary aggregator (qanoonsa.com/nezams.com). nezams.com's own structured summary of Resolution 69's 14 amendment items was successfully fetched and corroborates this track's own direct PDF reading on substance (see verification_methodology_note). qanoniah.com's dedicated page for this law is a JavaScript-rendered document viewer that did not yield extractable article text via WebFetch this pass (only navigation-chrome text was returned). qanoonsa.com's own indexed page for this law yielded only WebSearch-snippet-level fragments (a partial, non-contiguous subset of Article 3's powers), not a full verbatim cross-check. Both are flagged as attempted-but-inconclusive rather than silently omitted.

No amendment decree or the base resolution's own recital names a predecessor law that this statute repealed or replaced -- consistent with REGA being a newly created authority in 1438H/2017G (its founding resolution's own recital cites only a Royal Diwan referral and a Ministry of Housing letter proposing the Authority's creation, not a prior REGA-equivalent statute). This is flagged per this corpus's convention of recording predecessor-search outcomes (whether positive or negative) rather than leaving the question unaddressed.

This law's own Article 5 (paragraph 3, as amended) and Article 10 reference internal administrative/financial لوائح and 'مراكز الخدمة الشاملة' to be established/approved by the Board, and a separate 1447H Council of Ministers decision (read on the cover pages of the rega_amend_para1_board.pdf, item ثانياً) references a yet-to-be-fully-constituted Board committee on non-Saudi real-estate-ownership governance. None of these implementing regulations or the referenced committee's own governing text is ingested, fabricated, or partially guessed at in this pass -- flagged as candidates for dedicated follow-up ingestion.

**تنبيه سريان**: النسخة المُستوعبة هنا منشورة بتاريخ 2025-07-02، وقد رصد تدقيق السريان (scripts/audit_corpus_currency.py) إشعار تعديل واحداً في أرشيف جريدة أم القرى **بعد** هذا التاريخ، يحمل عنوانه اسم هذه الأداة بكل كلماته المميِّزة ونوعها ذاته (تنظيم/ترتيبات تنظيمية): 2025-08-22 — تعديل الفقرة (1) من المادة الرابعة من تنظيم الهيئة العامة للعقار (https://www.uqn.gov.sa/details?p=27365). **الإشعار ليس نص التعديل**، ولذلك لا يُدَّعى هنا شيء عن مضمونه ولم يُعدَّل نص أي مادة استناداً إليه. والمطابقة على العنوان لا على المتن، وقد يَرِد اسم أداة داخل عنوانٍ موضوعُه أداة مجاورة، فالصفحة الرسمية المذكورة هي الفيصل. المُفصَح عنه هو أن نص هذا المسار **قد لا يكون محدَّثاً**. يُرفع هذا التنبيه فقط عند استيعاب النص المعدَّل من مصدر رسمي. (تاريخ الطبعة أعلاه محسوب من التاريخ الهجري المُثبَت في المصدر، لا مقروءاً من ترويسة الجريدة؛ وقد اشتُرط فارق ثلاثين يوماً على الأقل حتى لا يُنتج خطأ التحويل تنبيهاً كاذباً.)
